business_profile.label: Municipal Signage Contractor
business_profile.name: Metro Signage Works Ltd.
business_profile.business_type: traffic signage, wayfinding signage, sign fabrication, sign installation, and pavement marking contractor

chunks.text: Bidders must provide proof of WSIB clearance and a traffic control plan. Bidders shall submit the completed schedule of prices.
The contractor shall fabricate and install wayfinding signage, traffic signage, and pavement markings. Bidders must hold a valid permit for work in the municipal right of way.
